data.message: Switch RollerCoin accounts freely without needing admin approval
changelog: Payment details are now always visible, allowing you to subscribe whenever you want
Error messages now disappear automatically after 10 seconds
Email is now always visible in Account so you can quickly copy it and log in to RollerCoin
You can expand or collapse the RollerCoin screen for a better viewing experience
Added an option to clear cache data in the RollerCoin screen
